commands_used: answer 1. I work for the Toh-Reel-Ka (Never-Writes-Twice is my officer). The Hist trees are sick and I must collect three seal-stones to open the gate at Teku-Sul Spire and reach the Eye of Argonia before the Unbound do. 2. Get into Blackrose Prison and take the thief stone from the warden vault in Raj-Kaal Hall; first I must get past gate-captain Corvus Ulvius. 3. Pay him 300 gold, persuade him with words, or duel him; or climb the walls unseen (risky), or fight. The raj-kaal Okaz-Teel holds the vault key on his belt. Corvus says an Imperial in the hall already has a buyer for the vault contents. 4. Not sure who the Imperial buyer is, or how to get the key from Okaz-Teel; I can find out by talking to people inside.

answer 1. I paid the toll and am now a guest at Blackrose; the Heirs will not attack me. I still need the thief seal-stone from the Warden Vault in Okaz-Teel hall. 2. Go into Raj-Kaal Hall and get the vault key or open the vault. 3. Buy the key from Okaz-Teel for 1,000 gold (favoured), lift it from his belt, or pick the vault lock at night. A seen theft turns the garrison on me. The Collector Ennodius Vanin is in the hall as guest and wants the contents too. 4. I do not know if I have 1,000 gold (I paid 300); I can check my journal. The ring of Kothringi silver the Collector has is unclear to me.

answer 1. I bought the vault key from Okaz-Teel for 1,000 gold; he says the stone is mine. 2. Open the Warden Vault door in his hall and take the seal-stone from the Warden Chest. 3. Just use the key on the vault door and take the stone; no other choice is in front of me. 4. Nothing new that I do not understand; the Imperial Collector may try to interfere, which I will see.

answer 1. I have the first seal-stone from Blackrose; two remain, at the flooded vaults of Gemin and the deepest hall of Vorannuhl. I must get all three before the Unbound to open the gate at Teku-Sul Spire and reach the Eye to heal the Hist. 2. Go to Gemin (walk from Jal-Veesa) or Vorannuhl (boat near Noota Nara), in either order, and take the stones. 3. Choose which first; both are marked. 4. I do not know what guards either place; I will find out when I arrive. Still open: why the Unbound seal trees they drain, and what moans in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar.

answer I work for the Toh-Reel-Ka as a Reel-Ka under Never-Writes-Twice. I paid the gate-captain 300 gold at Blackrose, then bought the warden vault key from Okaz-Teel for 1,000, and took the first Seal-Stone of the Kings. I carry it with about 350 gold, the Eye-Setting, Keystone, paralysis poison x3, sap jar, rapier, Reelka armour and the Warden Vault Key. Two stones remain: the flooded vaults of Gemin (walk from Jal-Veesa, rootworm) and the deepest hall of Vorannuhl (boat near Noota Nara). All three go into the gate at the drowned Teku-Sul Spire off Lilmoth, which leads to the Eye at the Root. Open questions: why the Unbound seal trees they drain, what moans in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar and where its key is, and how Nesh-Deeka knows so much about the Unbound. The Collector, Ennodius Vanin, is rival hunting the same relics.
